questions.q: Two numbers 2 and 8 have HCF 2 with coprime multipliers 1 and 4. Verify by computing hcf = 2 x 1; then find the HCF value.
Find the LCM of 2 and 8 given their HCF is 2 and HCF x LCM = product of the numbers.
The LCM of 2 and 8 is 8. Use HCF x LCM = a x b to find their HCF.
Two ropes of lengths 2 cm and 8 cm are cut into equal pieces of greatest length. What is the length of each piece?
Two bells ring together now. They ring at intervals of 2 minutes and 8 minutes. After how many minutes will they next ring together?
How many multiples of 12 are there up to 120?
Two numbers 50 and 70 have HCF 10 with coprime multipliers 5 and 7. Verify by computing hcf = 10 x 1; then find the HCF value.
Find the LCM of 50 and 70 given their HCF is 10 and HCF x LCM = product of the numbers.
The LCM of 50 and 70 is 350. Use HCF x LCM = a x b to find their HCF.

How many multiples of 30 are there up to 100?

Divisibility by 11: add and subtract alternate digits of 2728 from the right (8 - 2 + 7 - 2) and report the result.
